sql: SELECT 'A_pnl_by_day' AS what, to_char(date_trunc('day',closed_at),'MM-DD')||' '||strategy AS k, to_char(SUM(pnl),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text AS v FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4','Emmsell10') AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_cumulative_since_arm', strategy, to_char(SUM(pnl),'FM990.0000')||' n='||count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') AND closed_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'C_live_orders', COALESCE(status,'?'), count(*)::text||' last='||to_char(max(created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'D_open_pos', strategy, count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4','mmsell10') AND closed_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'E_integrity_err', e.kind||' '||COALESCE(x.key,'?'), to_char(e.detected_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI')||' resolved='||COALESCE(to_char(e.resolved_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI'),'NO') FROM experiment_integrity_events e LEFT JOIN experiments x ON x.id=e.experiment_id WHERE e.severity='error' AND e.resolved_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'F_deploys_open', d.deployment_key||' ['||d.kind||']', COALESCE(string_agg(da.strategy_tag,','),'-') FROM experiment_deployments d LEFT JOIN experiment_deployment_arms da ON da.deployment_id=d.id WHERE d.ended_at IS NULL AND d.deployment_key LIKE 'mmsell-contestcap%' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'G_twin_epoch_open', twin_tag||' <- '||live_tag, to_char(started_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_paper_twins WHERE ended_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'H_last_scan', to_char(max(created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), count(*)::text||' cycles in 2h' FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY 1,2
